versions.changelog:
Initial release of the construction-pm skill — a toolkit for construction project management workflows.

- Tracks construction jobs through all lifecycle stages (lead to paid) with append-only history.
- Generates daily project manager briefings on job status, stale jobs, permits, and pipeline revenue.
- Monitors permits for aging or pending status, with user-defined thresholds.
- Parses emails from field staff to extract job updates, status changes, and permit info.
- Provides command-line scripts for easy job management, updates, and pipeline summaries.
- Data stored as JSON for auditability and easy integration; outputs formatted for Markdown delivery.
